BUILDING CONSTRUCTION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #8
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: BUILDING CONSTRUCTION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Internal Cooking Timer
   B. Information and Communication Technology
   C. Input Cable Tester
   D. International Cricket Team

2. When learning Introduction to Building Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Building Drawing.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Building Drawing.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Building Drawing.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Building Drawing.

3. When learning Building Material Schedules, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Building Material Schedules.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Building Material Schedules.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Building Material Schedules.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Building Material Schedules.

4. When learning Fixings and Fittings, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Fixings and Fittings.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Fixings and Fittings.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Fixings and Fittings.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Fixings and Fittings.

5. When learning Floor Finishes, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Floor Finishes.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Floor Finishes.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Floor Finishes.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Floor Finishes.

6. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Remove all guards
   B. Work alone with eyes closed
   C. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   D. Run with the tool

7. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. CPU
   B. Speaker
   C. Keyboard
   D. Monitor

8. When learning Computer Aided Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Aided Drawing.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer Aided Drawing.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Computer Aided Drawing.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer Aided Drawing.

9. When learning Ceilings, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Ceilings.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Ceilings.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Ceilings.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Ceilings.

10. When learning Careers and Entrepreneurship in Building Construction, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Careers and Entrepreneurship in Building Construction.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Careers and Entrepreneurship in Building Construction.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Careers and Entrepreneurship in Building Construction.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Careers and Entrepreneurship in Building Construction.

11. When learning Building Construction Project Phase 11, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Building Construction Project Phase 11.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Building Construction Project Phase 11.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Building Construction Project Phase 11.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Building Construction Project Phase 11.

12. When learning Wall Finishes, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Wall Finishes.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Wall Finishes.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Wall Finishes.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Wall Finishes.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Ceilings and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Fixings and Fittings and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Pre-cast Concrete Products and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Building Material Schedules and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
